_note: Admission test: a delegated result is inherited as finished work by default. If nobody inspects it, later work is built on an unverified artifact and the missing observation cannot be reconstructed after the session ends; healing requires discarding the inherited result and restarting the work, path (3). _note: Admission test: a checker included in its own observation can create a stable false-positive process count. That apparent presence is then used as fact, and repeated checks reproduce the same observer contamination; doing nothing never reveals the absent target. Recovery requires interrupting the accepted result and rerunning from a correctly separated observer, effectively restarting the decision path (3). The verdict's broad pgrep/pkill/killall branch is narrowed away because it does not require a grep process in a ps pipeline and would interrupt ordinary process operations unrelated to self-inclusion. _note: P01 guards the same occasion and accepts Read/Glob/Grep as discharge, which answers a different question: reading establishes what the repository IS, not what was ASKED FOR. A plan can therefore be adopted having read forty files and asked nothing, and P01 counts it discharged. The two failure modes are independent -- a plan grounded in the tree can still be a plan for the wrong task -- so this is a separate clause rather than a widened P01. Against the admission test: left alone, a plan built on a guessed reading is FOLLOWED, because a plan's default is adoption and nothing in the run re-opens the interpretation. The state it leaves is work completed under the wrong goal, and that heals only by throwing the session away and starting over -- path (3), an ACTION, and the most expensive one. Its interruption cost is bounded by the occasion: ExitPlanMode is rare per session and one question discharges it for the whole session.

occasion: HEAD moved to a commit that already existed -- a switch or checkout, through whatever program

_natural_guard: Creating a ref is discharged by work someone actually does: `git checkout -B REF origin/main` is how a session makes the branch it later returns to, and creation is the strongest possible proof the ref exists. Measured on the frozen corpus: the sole U09 denial checked out `claude/gyroscope-terminal-clauses`, a branch the same session had created 12 calls earlier with `git checkout -B` -- the guard was already run, under a name the old discharged_by refused to see. `git rev-parse --verify` remains the explicit probe for refs the session did not make.

occasion: the act printed a null datum, or nothing at all while reading a structured file -- through whatever program
costly: traverse structured JSON data
guard: look at the structure first: `jq 'keys'`, `jq 'type'`, `jq -e 'has(...)'`, or any jq structure assertion on the same file
deny_reason: a traversal of structured data produced null; look at the structure before the next act: `jq 'keys'`, `jq 'type'`, `jq -e 'has(...)'`, or Read the file
_natural_guard: The old guard demanded specifically `jq -e` with a type/has assertion -- a ritual observed 0 times in 2152 real Bash calls. The observation people actually make before traversing a JSON file is `jq 'keys'` or `jq 'type'` on it: measured on the frozen corpus, the session ran `jq 'keys' FILE` before every per-file traversal chain (e.g. call 2100 `jq 'keys' calibration_preregistered.json` precedes 2104 `jq 'del(.tasks)'` on the same file). That look is the guard -- it answers the same question (what shape is this document) and is discharged by work that is already part of the job. `jq -e` still discharges. COMPOSED over the host surface, the same move U12 and U19 took to Grep: reading the file IS looking at its structure, and `Read` is a CLOSED host enum, so naming it retires a vocabulary instead of widening one -- a `jq`-only guard is monotone in vocabulary (Coverings.v Thm 5) and is defeated by inspecting the file any other way. The subject had to move with it: a Read carries its file in `tool_input.file_path`, not in a command, so with a single-field subject the composed guard would key to "" and discharge nothing.
